header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: in Du'a) what words are for me?” He said: “(اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْلِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي) O Allah! Forgive me! Have mercy on me! Show me the right path! Provide for me! Grant me well-being!”” In another narration it is said that the Prophet ﷺ said, “These words will gather for you the good of this world and the Hereafter.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ بِيَدِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ:هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاء في عقد التسبيح باليد رقم:٣٤٨٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ doing tasbih while counting on his blessed fingers.”

blocks.text: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ؕ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) when My servants ask you about Me, (say:) “Indeed I am near (to them); I respond to the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ مَايَعْبَؤُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُم۞).
